integrity: Both Rota-Baxter identities are reconstructed directly from the binary and ternary products. The arbitrary-field classification uses no division by characteristic-sensitive integers. A standalone symbolic and exhaustive checker replays the equations, finite-field counts, ranks, automorphisms, and orbit sizes.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats only the two-dimensional Lie-Yamaguti algebra in Zhao-Qiao Example 4.16.
The displayed source family is valid and is not claimed by the source to be exhaustive; the result supplies the complete operator locus.
No deformation or cohomology group is computed.
title: Complete Rota–Baxter moduli of a two-dimensional Lie–Yamaguti example
